chunks: It is narrated from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥarīz, from al-Walīd, who said:
Whoever abandons marriage out of fear of poverty has thought poorly of Allah, Mighty and Majestic. Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says:
If they are poor, Allah will enrich them out of His bounty.

key_terms.أَسَاءَ الظَّنَّ: held a bad opinion or suspected wrongly
key_terms.فَضْلِهِ: His bounty, grace, and generous provision
key_terms.مَخَافَةَ: fear or apprehension motivating a decision
key_terms.يُغْنِهِمُ: He will enrich them or make them independent of need

ai.seo_question: Does fearing poverty justify avoiding marriage in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that refraining from marriage due to fear of poverty reflects سوء الظنّ, a poor opinion of Allah’s provision. It reinforces trust in Allah’s bounty and cites the Qur’anic promise that He can enrich the poor from His grace.
